contracts: (Exact-cover validation confirms reverse coverage for every Atomic Obligation-to-command edge and reports no orphan obligation or command node.) AND (The S20 selector reports complete forward and reverse assertion coverage for every Atomic Obligation and rejects orphan mappings.) AND (The compiled graph has no forward-only selector coverage and no selector node without reverse Atomic Obligation coverage.)

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["py", "-3", "-m", "pytest", ".agents/skills/vdd-conformance-exact-cover/tests/validators/exact_cover_negative.py"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Run the authored S20 selector with an orphaned forward or reverse Atomic Obligation-to-assertion mapping.
Run the exact-cover negative validator against a selector mapping with an omitted reverse Atomic Obligation relation and require graph validation to fail.
